title: Best practical Ds solver with theorem-backed certificate
statement: Synthesize efficient-score upper optimization, inductive fitting, exact Ds exchange refinement, held-out evaluation, and upper-bound gap reporting under the audited DS17 constraints. On the scalar population-conditionally-centered class (L), the full (M2)+(M3)+(M5) ordinary-stable class is eventually empty, so any margin-constrained output must be reported as constrained, priced by v_hat_K - Phi_hat_s, and non-inductive; the established compile route is the projected efficient-score interval rule with its DP ceiling. Off (L), DS18 proves that one exact non-centered law has a unique strict full-rank population optimum and almost-sure transfer through finite global regular Ds optimizers. DS18 was independently audited on 31 Aug 2026 and verified with hardened assumptions; the audit supplies a computable finite-N certificate Delta_N = v_hat_3,N - Phi_hat(z*_N) that needs no combinatorial search and converts any labeling's value gap into a bound on its disagreement with the population rule. The remaining practical problem is therefore sharp: exhibit a polynomial-time labeling rule whose output satisfies Delta-consistency (v_hat_3,N - Phi_hat(z_tilde_N) -> 0 a.s.) on this law, which would inherit the whole transfer and turn the global-oracle theorem into a solver certificate, and extend that to computable margins and value guarantees under perturbations of the law.

proof_location.section: OP7. Best practical \(D_s\) solver with theorem-backed certificate

warning: Do not expose a generic gate root as a certificate. DS18 supplies sufficiency and finite exchange-stable transfer only through global regular optimization for its named exact law, under the in-bin (DS9) feasibility convention; it does not prove basin selection by local ascent or perturbation robustness. The DS18 audit is complete (AUDITS/AUDIT-DS-NONCENTERED-GLOBAL-BASIN-TRANSFER-001.md) and authorizes no src/ change.
